content.descriptor: Korean hand, body and lip care: a hand balm on a chain that is worn on the outside of a bag, and three formulations — Stressfree, Waterdrop and Sun Off
about: SLOW LOUNGE is a Korean brand of hand, body and lip care. It is made by TeamPass, a company based in Seoul, and the brand launched in January 2026.

The company builds the brand around how a product feels in use rather than around a list of functions. Its own brand book puts it plainly: slow the rhythm of the day for a moment and find calm again through your hands.

The most recognisable item in the range is a hand balm on a chain with a clasp. People clip it to a bag, a phone or a tumbler, so the cream ends up within reach where it usually is not. The company calls this format a keyring hand cream, and it is what gives the brand visibility in short video and on a shelf.
The second product built the same way is a square lip balm that the company pairs with a phone grip. The brand reads as different on the shelf before a shopper gets to the ingredient list.
facts: The brand launched in January 2026; the operating company is TeamPass, Seoul
Three core formulations: Stressfree on patented B-Circadin™, Waterdrop on Italian thermal water and ceramides, Sun Off with New Zealand Manuka honey and SPF
The keyring format: a clasp and a chain, clipped to a bag, a phone or a tumbler
The company states that the Stressfree line completed clinical testing across seven parameters
The company states an irritation index of 0.00 for the Stressfree and Waterdrop lines
The company declares a vegan formulation and an EWG Green grade for the Waterdrop line
channels: Retail chains and specialist beauty stores
Buyers who need a product that stands out on the shelf

lines.name: Stressfree
lines.note: The brand's core line. It contains a patented bush clover ingredient, B-Circadin™, at 3 per cent, along with NAD+, NMN, adenosine and niacinamide. The company describes care for skin under stress, blue light defence and support for the skin's daily rhythm. The line covers a hand balm, a body balm and a body wash; the body fragrance is described as aromatic woody.

lines.name: Waterdrop
lines.note: The hydrating line, built on Italian thermal water, a five-ceramide complex and moisture capsules. The texture is described as a jelly that turns to water on application. The company names microfluidic encapsulation as the way active ingredients are held stable. The line covers a hand balm, a body balm and a body wash; the body fragrance is watery muguet.

lines.name: Sun Off
lines.note: The line for everyday sun protection: SPF 15 PA++ for hands and SPF 10 PA++ for lips. It contains New Zealand Manuka honey at UMF 20+ and the same B-Circadin™. The company describes a hundred-hour honey process: fifty hours of fermentation and fifty hours of low-temperature aging.

lines.name: Nude
lines.note: A tinted lip balm in a square jar. It gives a natural tint and, in the company's description, works on evening out tone. This is the format the brand pairs with a phone grip.

tech.name: B-Circadin™, a patented ingredient
tech.note: A bush clover extract the company uses at 3 per cent in the Stressfree and Sun Off lines. According to the company it works on care for skin under stress, blue light defence and support for the skin's daily rhythm.

tech.name: Italian thermal water and five ceramides
tech.note: The base of the Waterdrop line. The company names mineral-rich thermal water, a five-ceramide complex, natural moisturising factors and hyaluronic acid which, by its data, holds up to six thousand times its own weight in water.

tech.name: Microfluidic capsules
tech.note: The delivery method the company names in the Waterdrop line. The capsules open on application and the texture moves from jelly to water.

tech.name: Manuka honey at UMF 20+
tech.note: The ingredient behind the Sun Off line. The company names New Zealand honey selected from under one per cent of production and a hundred-hour process: fifty hours of fermentation with yeast and probiotics plus fifty hours of low-temperature aging.

tech.name: Packaging as part of the product
tech.note: A clasp and chain on the hand balm, a square jar for the lip balm and a separate phone grip. The company designs these formats to be carried on the outside of a bag rather than inside it.

formats: Lip balms in a square jar
SPF products for hands and lips
A phone grip as an accessory to the balm
content.exportNote: The company is expanding its overseas distribution and, in its letter of 26 August 2026, named an interest in South America directly. It did not tell us which export markets it currently serves, so we do not list any. Teranova works across Latin America and North America and matches the brand to countries and channels where the keyring format reads immediately, without a long explanation.

terms.label: Forms of cooperation
terms.value: Wholesale supply of finished products under the SLOW LOUNGE brand. The company is open to working with importers, distributors, retail and professional sales channels.

terms.label: Geography
terms.value: The company's priority is entering new overseas markets, with an interest in South America named specifically. The publication authorization is non-exclusive: Teranova is not its agent or distributor.

terms.label: Prices
terms.value: Price on request. We do not publish the company's export price list: supply prices in the open destroy a brand's retail pricing in other countries. Current terms reach the buyer at the deal stage through Teranova, shown separately from the cost of our own services.

terms.label: Minimum order
terms.value: The minimum batch has not been provided; we are requesting it from TeamPass for a specific item list.

terms.label: How the work runs
terms.value: Enquiry → Teranova checks and agrees the scope → negotiation and samples → logistics, customs and payment handled end to end.

content.consentNote: The data, images and materials were provided by TeamPass, owner of the SLOW LOUNGE brand, and are published with its written authorization of 28 August 2026. Stated properties, formulations and test results are given as reported by the company.
content.seoTitle: SLOW LOUNGE — Korean hand, body and lip care · Teranova
content.seoDesc: SLOW LOUNGE by TeamPass: a Korean hand balm on a chain worn on the outside of a bag, the Stressfree, Waterdrop and Sun Off lines, body and lip care. Wholesale supply and export through Teranova.
catalog_notes: Balm for Hand, Stressfree — the keyring balm itself: a clasp and chain let it be carried on the outside of a bag. A rich balm texture, with B-Circadin™ at 3 per cent, NAD+, NMN, adenosine and niacinamide. The company states clinical testing across seven parameters.
Balm for Body, Stressfree — a body balm on the same patented ingredient. The company describes the fragrance as aromatic woody.
Wash for Body, Stressfree — the body wash of the same line, a gel that turns to foam. The fragrance is aromatic woody, as in the balm.

Balm for Hand, Waterdrop — the keyring balm of the hydrating line. The texture is described as a jelly that turns to water on application; it contains Italian thermal water, five ceramides and moisture capsules.
Balm for Body, Waterdrop — a body balm with the same water texture. The company describes the fragrance as watery muguet.
Wash for Body, Waterdrop — the Waterdrop body wash, moving from gel to foam. The fragrance is watery muguet.
Balm for Hand, Sun Off — the keyring balm with everyday sun protection at SPF 15 PA++. It contains New Zealand Manuka honey at UMF 20+ and B-Circadin™.
Balm for Lip, Sun Off — a square lip balm at SPF 10 PA++. The company positions it as everyday lip protection rather than a beach product.
Balm for Lip, Nude — a tinted balm in a square jar: a natural tint and care in one. This is the format the brand pairs with a phone grip.

ui.products_note: Hand, body and lip care in four formulations. Stressfree is built on patented B-Circadin™, Waterdrop on thermal water and ceramides, Sun Off adds SPF and Manuka honey, Nude gives lips a natural tint. Price on request.
ui.terms_disc: Prices and terms are indicative and are finalised at the deal stage through Teranova. Direct supplier contacts are not published: Teranova Group runs the negotiation, the checks and the delivery.
ui.cta_d: Get in touch — Teranova arranges the negotiation, the checks and the whole deal from first contact to delivery.
ui.certs_note: The marks are taken from the company's own materials: a vegan formulation, an EWG Green grade and dermatological testing. We were not sent copies of the reports, so the marks are shown as declared by the company.
ui.gallery_note: The still photographs were provided by TeamPass. They show what the keyring format is for: the balm hangs on a bag beside earphones and glasses instead of lying at the bottom of it. These are the company's own materials, not our factory visit: the supplier status is “Information provided by the company”.
